messages:
maya-people-ops: Quick heads-up — this is the last 48h push for the annual SOC2/ISO evidence drop + privacy attestation. Deadline: 48 hours from now (Fri 23:59 UTC). Please prioritize any outstanding artifacts and attestation tasks.

maya-people-ops: What we need from each team: 1) Upload evidentiary artifacts to the compliance bucket, 2) Link artifacts on the tracking sheet, 3) Confirm attestation checkboxes in the portal. Short checklist below.

maya-people-ops: Upload path (use your team folder): `s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/2026-attestation/<team-name>/`
maya-people-ops: Naming convention: `<YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control-id>_<brief>.pdf` — e.g. `20260511_api_team_SC-07_token_rotate.pdf`

maya-people-ops: Tracking sheet (update row when upload complete): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/COMPLIANCE-ATT-TRACKER
maya-people-ops: Exception form (only for genuine blockers): https://forms.gle/compliance-exception-2026 — submit + @maya-people-ops as owner.

maya-people-ops: Office hours for the next 48h (drop-in):
- Thu 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT — Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/111222333
- Fri 02:00 UTC / 19:00 PT — Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/444555666 (late shift)

jamie-security: Quick Q — if an artifact contains PII, should teams redact or upload to a restricted folder?

maya-people-ops: @jamie-security: redact where possible. If redaction removes context, upload to restricted folder and set ACL to "private-compliance" and notify security. Use KMS key `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/compliance` if you encrypt client data at rest.

sam-eng: Do infra runbooks / oncall logs count? I have 2 PRs pending that reference internal ticket numbers.

maya-people-ops: Yes — runbooks and oncall logs are valid evidence. Please either 1) attach a sanitized snippet, or 2) upload the full log to the restricted folder and add a note on the tracking sheet indicating redaction. Link the PRs in the evidence metadata.

tess-eng-mgr: What about contractors — do they need to fill the attestation?

maya-people-ops: Contractors do not submit the attestation themselves. Their artifacts should be uploaded by the sponsoring team and the sponsor must attest on their behalf. If a contractor is primary evidence owner, file the exception form and cc compliance.

jamie-security: Reminder: do not include credentials, keys, or screenshots with secrets. If you find secrets, rotate before uploading and note rotation in the evidence metadata.

maya-people-ops: TL;DR checklist for upload (copy into your channel):
- Upload artifact to `s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/2026-attestation/<team>/`
- Add link + notes to Tracking Sheet row
- Mark control as "evidence uploaded" in portal
- If redaction needed, use restricted folder + notify security
- If blocker, file exception form and join office hours

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Compliance evidence deadline — 24 hours left" will post in #people-ops in 24h. :alarm_clock:

sam-eng: Acknowledged. I'll pull the runbook + logs tonight and drop them in the restricted folder.

tess-eng-mgr: Thanks @maya-people-ops — scheduling a short team sync now.

maya-people-ops: Thank you all — ping me for any triage. If you can't make office hours, DM and we'll find a time. :raised_hands:
